provenance.rationale: Two compact sampled P1/P0 XZ complement regions are filled as bounded land continuity patches. Their boundaries are derived from serialized package geometry; the ROI extents originate in a 0.25 m occupancy probe and are not surveyed land boundaries. Height support prefers logical tile 49; cross-owner height disagreement is retained as a diagnostic and does not change the selected logical surface.

supplementary_inputs.limitation: not historical source-video registration and not survey-grade land ownership

r42c_route_attribute_chart.source: target-owner serialized tile49 road triangle attributes
r42c_route_attribute_chart.policy: For newly appended land-infill vertices within 0.02m of tile49 road faces, assign _ROUTE_S/_ROUTE_U by unrestricted affine barycentrics at the vertex original world XZ. Do not snap/clamp positions or copy foreign-owner route attributes.
r42c_route_attribute_chart.purpose: Prevent false route-relative road-band validation overlaps caused by chord projection at curved road edges; XYZ and surface faces remain unchanged.

height_rule.description: At supported XZ points, prefer target tile 49 road P0 at road boundaries, otherwise target tile 49 terrain P1; among overlapping triangles of the selected owner/layer choose the topmost surface with deterministic primitive/triangle tie-break and gate same-owner/layer spread at 2 mm. Cross-owner differences are diagnostic only and never averaged. Use target-owner P1 then P0 samples for deterministic inverse-square four-neighbor continuity at unsupported decomposition/interior vertices; borrow one foreign owner only if target-owner support is absent within the configured distance. Never use camera height or y=0.

regions.boundary_provenance: estimated from package-wide P1/P0 serialized triangle complement inside the occupancy-derived ROI; current OSM is supplementary only
